title: Suricatoos — Fleet Node Heartbeat
description: POST /fleet/v1/heartbeat (ADR-0011), outbound mTLS, every heartbeat_interval_s (default 60). The request carries the current content_sha256 of every state kind the node has; the hub compares them with the snapshots it holds and lists in 'resync' the kinds it wants re-sent in full (PUT /fleet/v1/state/{kind}). server_time lets the node measure clock offset (command windows depend on it). node_id must equal the CN of the client certificate. The root accepts either message; implementations validate the specific $defs entry.

state_hashes.description: kind -> content_sha256 of the node's latest snapshot of that kind

outbox_events.description: events waiting in the durable outbox

outbox_dropped.description: events dropped since start because the outbox cap was hit (oldest first)

pending_results.description: acks/results/artifacts not yet accepted by the hub

resync.description: kinds to re-send in full; empty = nothing to do
